## 識別の考え方

図解（tikz）の例

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=0.55cm and 0.9cm]
  \node[box_node] (all) {全体の標本};
  \node[box_node, below left=of all] (treat) {処置群};
  \node[box_node, below right=of all] (ctrl) {対照群};
  \node[key_node, below=1.9cm of all] (cmp) {比較して効果を推定};
  \draw[arrow] (all) -- (treat);
  \draw[arrow] (all) -- (ctrl);
  \draw[arrow] (treat) -- (cmp);
  \draw[arrow] (ctrl) -- (cmp);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

\slidenote{Note: box\_node = 通常のノード、key\_node = 結論の 1 ノードだけ。}

## 推定式

**Model 1**（推定式の名前）

\begin{equation}
Y_{it} = \beta D_{it} + \gamma X_{it} + \alpha_i + \lambda_t + \varepsilon_{it}
\end{equation}
\begin{defbox}
\begin{itemize}\small
  \item[] \textbf{Outcome variable}
    \begin{itemize}
      \item $Y_{it}$：アウトカム（単位）
    \end{itemize}
  \item[] \textbf{Main explanatory variables}
    \begin{itemize}
      \item $D_{it}$：処置の変数。基準は\textcolor{accent}{参照カテゴリ}
      \item $X_{it}$：統制変数
    \end{itemize}
\end{itemize}
\end{defbox}
